questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "bounce" mean?
options: A quick recovery after a decline
questions.explain_en: Here "bounce" refers to the index quickly recovering after it fell the previous day.
questions.explain_zh: 這裡的「bounce」指的是指數在前一天下跌後快速回升。

questions.question: How many points did the TAIEX index rise intraday before the gains narrowed?
questions.explain_en: The summary says the index rallied more than 500 points intraday before the gains narrowed.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說指數在盤中上漲超過 500 點後，漲幅才收斂。

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "up-cycle" mean?
options: A period when prices and demand are falling
A period when prices and demand are rising
questions.explain_en: An up-cycle is a phase where market prices and demand are increasing, as described for memory makers.
questions.explain_zh: 上升循環指的是市場價格與需求同時上升的階段，正如文中所說的記憶體製造商的情況。

questions.question: According to the summary, by how much are NAND Flash contract prices expected to rise in Q4?
questions.explain_en: The summary states NAND Flash prices are projected to increase by 15–20% in the fourth quarter.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中提到第四季 NAND Flash 合約價格預計上漲 15% 到 20%。
questions.news_title_en: Server DRAM and NAND Flash contract prices seen rising another 10–20% in Q4 on AI demand

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "succession‑planning" mean?
options: Planning how to open new bank branches
Planning how to invest in stocks
Planning how to manage family wealth after a death
Planning how a company will replace its leaders
questions.explain_en: "Succession‑planning" refers to arranging how family wealth or a business will be handled and transferred after someone dies or retires.
questions.explain_zh: 「succession‑planning」指的是在有人過世或退休後，安排家族財產或企業的傳承與管理方式。

questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明存款比例下降至 39.4%，為自 2022 年 4 月以來的最低。

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "exemption" mean?
options: A tax that must be paid
A rule that reduces the tax amount
questions.explain_en: An exemption is a rule that reduces or removes the amount of tax you have to pay.
questions.explain_zh: 「exemption」指的是減免稅額的規定，讓納稅人可以少付或不付稅。

questions.question: According to the summary, how much could a taxpayer save at a 10% estate‑tax rate after the exemption increase?
questions.explain_en: The text says the higher exemption could save taxpayers about NT$145,000 at a 10% rate.
questions.explain_zh: 文中說，按10%稅率計算，提升免稅額可為納稅人節省約145,000新台幣。

questions.question: In the summary, what does the phrase "risk-off stance" mean?
options: A plan to raise interest rates
A willingness to take more financial risks
questions.explain_en: A "risk-off stance" means investors prefer safer assets and avoid risky ones.
questions.explain_zh: 「risk-off stance」指的是投資人偏好較安全的資產，避免冒險投資。

questions.question: According to the summary, why did the market rebuild bets on a Fed rate hike for the Oct 27‑28 meeting?
options: Because the CPI fell below target
Because the Fed announced a cut in rates
questions.explain_en: The market rebuilt bets because September's CPI increased 0.6% month‑on‑month, keeping inflation above target.
questions.explain_zh: 市場重新預期加息是因為 9 月的消費者物價指數環比上升 0.6%，通膨仍高於目標。
questions.news_title_en: Fed rate-hike bets build ahead of Oct 28 meeting as September inflation runs hot
